en.topic_title: Hong Kong swelters as Tropical Cyclone Dolphin sees temperatures exceed 38°C
en.topic_summary:
Temperatures exceeded 38 degrees Celsius in some parts of the city on Saturday, as Tropical Cyclone Dolphin brought a heatwave to Hong Kong.
